steps.code:
# Combine all liked songs from all pages
all_liked_songs = liked_songs_page1 + liked_songs_page2 + liked_songs_page3
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(all_liked_songs)}")

# Build album_id -> genre mapping from album library
album_genre_map = {album['album_id']: album['genre'] for album in albums_page1}
print("Album genre map:", album_genre_map)

# Count liked songs per genre (only for songs that belong to albums in the library)
from collections import Counter
genre_counts = Counter()
for song in all_liked_songs:
    album_id = song.get('album_id')
    if album_id is not None and album_id in album_genre_map:
        genre = album_genre_map[album_id]
        genre_counts[genre] += 1

print("Genre counts:", dict(genre_counts))
